title: Teaching machines and programmed learning
creator_credit: James Learmonth, Digby Duncan and Gateway Educational Films
brief_description: This film explains the use of teaching machines in the classroom. It demonstrates simple and complex machines and defines programmed learning into two types - linear and branching.
